creatureTransformation.name: Half-Dragon
prerequisites: Choose a dragon ancestry and compare the creature's size and CR with the source's breath-weapon table.

manualReview.reason: Choose the ancestry's wyrmling breath; below CR 2, recalculate CR.
Choose the ancestry's young-dragon breath; below CR 7, recalculate CR.
Choose the ancestry's adult-dragon breath; below CR 8, recalculate CR.
Breath area, damage, DC, and recharge depend on both chosen ancestry and size; no static template is applied.

creatureTransformation.name: Shadow Dragon
prerequisites: Confirm a true dragon exposed to the Shadowfell; a dracolich is ineligible.

entry.name: Living Shadow
entries: In dim light or darkness, the dragon resists damage except force, psychic, or radiant damage.

entry.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: In dim light or darkness, the dragon can Hide as a bonus action.

entry.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight, the dragon has disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception checks.

manualReview.reason: Resolve Stealth expertise and the light-dependent shadow traits.
Replace the original breath with its shadow form and determine bite, lair, and legendary changes.
If Shadow Breath reduces a Humanoid to 0 hit points, adjudicate its death and the resulting shadow; these steps do not create a creature.

creatureTransformation.name: Dracolich
prerequisites: Confirm the dragon's age and the circumstances of its transformation with the DM.

manualReview.reason: Resolve magic resistance, lost traits, and dracolich-specific features; the existing static copy template is not an application engine.

creatureTransformation.name: Spore Servant
prerequisites: Confirm the remains were once flesh and blood and animated by a myconid sovereign.

entry.name: Limited Blindsight
entries: The servant perceives creatures within 30 feet by blindsight and cannot see farther away.

manualReview.reason: Remove old traits, skills, saves, languages, tags, and special senses; blindsight has a beyond-range limitation.
Retain only permitted melee actions; assess an unarmed strike if none remain.
Reduce each movement speed by 10 feet, minimum 5, without replacing the chassis' movement types.

creatureTransformation.name: Vampire
prerequisites: Agree with the DM whether the subject becomes a vampire or a vampire spawn.

manualReview.reason: Resolve vampire regeneration, shapechanging, weaknesses, and legendary features.
Resolve spawn-specific regeneration, weaknesses, and dependence on its creator.
Resolve bite, charm, grapples, and form-dependent actions for the chosen outcome.

creatureTransformation.name: Lycanthropy
prerequisites: Confirm the curse, saving throw, and whether the subject accepts or resists it.

manualReview.reason: Add natural armor only in bear or hybrid form.
Add natural armor only in boar or hybrid form.
Add natural armor only in wolf or hybrid form.
Resolve silver-sensitive immunity, curse, and traits of the chosen form; ordinary immunity would be incorrect.
Resolve natural attacks, form-specific movement and speech, and weapon limitations.
The source's ability guidance addresses player characters; adjudicate its use on NPCs.

creatureTransformation.name: Skeleton
prerequisites: Confirm the body has a skeleton appropriate for reanimation.

manualReview.reason: Determine retained abilities, languages, and reanimation-specific changes for this chassis.

creatureTransformation.name: Zombie
prerequisites: Confirm a corpse that can be animated as a zombie.

manualReview.reason: Apply the DMG racial adjustments to this corpse's own scores, not the MM zombie's fixed scores.
Resolve Undead Fortitude and lost capabilities for the reanimated creature.

creatureTransformation.name: Wereshark
prerequisites: Resolve the wereshark curse and choose the humanoid, hybrid, or hunter-shark form.

entry.name: Change Shape
entries: As a bonus action, the wereshark takes humanoid, hybrid, or Large hunter-shark form. Its gear stays the same, and it reverts on death. The DM resolves each form's movement.

entry.name: Bite (Wereshark)
entries: A bite can curse a Humanoid with wereshark lycanthropy on a failed Constitution save; the save DC is 8 plus proficiency bonus plus Constitution modifier. The DM sets the bite's attack and damage.

manualReview.reason: Resolve Blood Frenzy and the full effects of Change Shape for the chosen form.
Add one point of natural armor in hybrid or shark form, not humanoid form.
Adapt the form-specific bite and its lycanthropy save from the original template.
Reconcile changed size, swimming speed, and equipment; do not copy ungranted monster-only features.

creatureTransformation.name: Skeletal Wyrmling
prerequisites: Confirm animate dead, three wyrmling bones, and blood from the dragon whose wyrmling stat block is used.

manualReview.reason: Only a wyrmling chassis from the blood donor qualifies, not every dragon.
Add one hit point for each Hit Die to account for the changed Constitution.
Remove the breath weapon; do not silently keep it from the original chassis.
Understands its prior languages but cannot speak.

creatureTransformation.name: Shadow Dragon
prerequisites: Use the Shadow Dragon Template embedded in the page-25 adult black shadow dragon example, not the example's CR or alignment.

entry.name: Living Shadow
entries: In dim light or darkness, the dragon resists damage except force, psychic, or radiant damage.

entry.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: In dim light or darkness, the dragon can Hide as a bonus action.

entry.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight, the dragon has disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception checks.

manualReview.reason: Requires a true dragon associated with the Shadowfell; dracoliches are excluded.
Resolve doubled Stealth proficiency, conditional shadow resistance and hiding, and sunlight sensitivity.
Convert elemental bite and breath effects to necrotic; adjudicate a shadow created by lethal breath damage.

creatureTransformation.name: Fey Beast
prerequisites: Select traits and actions with the DM; the screenshot suggests a count tied to CR, minimum one.

entry.name: Sylvan Understanding
entries: If its Intelligence is at least 3, this creature understands Sylvan but does not gain the ability to speak it.

manualReview.reason: Set natural AC to 16 if the chosen feature applies.

entry.name: Fey-Touched
entries: The creature has advantage on saving throws against effects that charm or frighten it.

manualReview.reason: Resolve the once-daily Wisdom spell without spoken or material components.
Resolve the once-daily Wisdom spell without spoken or material components.

entry.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The creature has advantage on Stealth checks in forest or grassland terrain.

manualReview.reason: Resolve movement through plants, including magical manipulation of them.

entry.name: Rooted
entries: The creature has advantage on checks and saves against forced movement or being knocked prone.

manualReview.reason: Resolve movement between nearby living trees and its movement cost.
Resolve the nearest chosen kind of beast or plant within five miles.
Add a recharge 4-6, 30-foot teleport and its attack timing.
Page, edition, and screenshot attribution are not independently verified.
Reconcile any pre-existing ability to speak Sylvan.

creatureTransformation.name: Fallen Angel
prerequisites: Confirm this is an angel and agree on its fall with the DM.

entry.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: A creature touched by the angel must save against its spell DC or be charmed and follow its commands for up to one hour. Uses match the replaced Healing Touch.

manualReview.reason: Resolve lawful evil alignment, reduced flight, new skills, changed weapon damage and lost spells.
Set Corrupting Touch's save and the existing Healing Touch use count if present.
Mark the devil subtype; reconcile silver-bypassed defenses and Devil's Sight.
Change the angelic weapon's bonus damage to fire.
Replace truesight with darkvision of equal range, if present.
Screenshot page and edition are unverified; do not infer rules from the Fallen Planetar example.

creatureTransformation.name: Undead
prerequisites: Choose one undead category; additional features from the optional groups need DM approval and should fit the original CR.

entry.name: Undead Nature
entries: This creature needs no air, food, water, or sleep.

manualReview.reason: Replace movement with flight and hover; do not retain incompatible ground movement.
Determine whether Dexterity or Charisma substitutes on attacks.
Resolve movement through objects, including force damage when ending within one.

entry.name: Spider Climb
entries: The creature climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without needing an ability check.

manualReview.reason: Resolve once-per-turn draining damage, maximum-HP reduction, and healing.
Resolve conditional 10-HP regeneration and the applicable vampiric weaknesses.
Reduce all speeds by 10 feet but not below 5.
Add Undead Fortitude, with DC based on damage and exceptions for radiant damage and critical hits.
Resolve once-per-turn paralysis from ghoulish strikes against eligible targets.
Halve all speeds, minimum 20 feet.
Resolve rotting-strike necrosis and the CR-dependent mummy-rot curse.
Resolve the force-damage replacement on the original strikes.
Resolve the necrotic-damage replacement on the original strikes.
Check Ethereal Sight and resolve an action to change planes.
Apply the invitation restriction only if Intelligence is at least 6.
Resolve damage from ending a turn in running water.
Apply paralysis from a heart stake only while resting and incapacitated.
Apply damage and the attack and sight-check penalties in direct sunlight.
Apply repeated Constitution saves against paralysis, except to elves and undead.
At CR 2 or higher, resolve nearby poisoning and the successful target's temporary immunity.
Resolve the CR 5 damage increase, healing prevention, shrinking HP maximum, and curse removal.
Resolve aura range and damage with the DM.
Resolve detection range and creature exclusions.
Resolve vision into the Ethereal Plane.
Resolve survival and senses without a head.
Resolve once-daily casting and the appropriate save DC.
Resolve at-will casting and its level-dependent damage.

entry.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

manualReview.reason: Resolve healing from necrotic damage rather than treating it as immunity.
Resolve additional necrotic damage on eligible strikes.

entry.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: The creature can Hide as a bonus action while in dim light or darkness.

manualReview.reason: Requires Sunlight Sensitivity; confirm it is present or also selected.

entry.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In direct sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks.

manualReview.reason: Resolve the once-daily touch attack and damage.

entry.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The creature cannot be turned by effects that turn undead.

entry.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The creature has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

manualReview.reason: Resolve fear, paralysis on a severely failed save, and Multiattack integration.
Screenshot page, edition, and source attribution are unverified; confirm any CR-based option limits.
Determine alignment and other category-appropriate traits with the DM; the worked tyrannosaurus and hydra are examples, not defaults.
